static_review: Parser::atom accepts unary NOT and quoted phrases; Parser::and_expr accepts conjunctions of NOT atoms.
Both fts() and substring_fts() return unconstrained for NOT. With every AND child unconstrained, no candidate index can eliminate these documents.
The four phrases do not occur in the repeated lorem body, so each NOT is true and all AND branches must be evaluated.
The existing positive benchmark is not an overflow benchmark: substring_max_field_grams bounds distinct grams, not scanned codepoints.

Store::search_impl holds its mutex through candidate validation. The variant measures remaining blocking under the original workload shape; one observation cannot establish a general performance ratio.
